description:
Programme Overview

The Friedrich Schlegel Graduate School of Literary Studies (FSGS) at Freie Universität Berlin accepts dissertations of outstanding theoretical and conceptual quality that examine literature within a cultural-historical, transregional, transtemporal, and/or intermedial framework. The programme is a structured doctoral program that can only be studied full-time.

Positions and Grants for 2027

  • Up to 10 PhD positions at the FSGS for the duration of 3 to 4 years for candidates with secured external funding (scholarship or position as a Research Assistant) and without external funding.
  • Up to 5 outstanding applicants without external funding will receive a nine-month scholarship of EUR 1103 starting in June 2027 and take part in a series of workshops to secure external funding.
  • Accepted applicants who cannot be offered a scholarship will be supported by the management in obtaining scholarships or other external funding and can participate in selected events of the workshop series and complete digital modules.
  • 3 Fellowships at the FSGS for students of literature from the Global South for the duration of 3 months (subject to the availability of funds).
  • 1-2 CSC-Fellowships as part of the FUB-CSC program for graduate students in humanities with a focus on German Studies from the People's Republic of China.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Outstanding theoretical and conceptual quality of dissertation project.
  • Working languages: German and English.
  • Required degree: Master, Magister (Masters degree course).
  • Areas of study: American Studies, English Studies, German Studies, Philosophy, General Literary Studies, Comparative Literary Studies.

Required Documents

  • Certificates
  • CV
  • Motivation letter
  • Transcripts
  • Research expose
  • List of publications
  • References
  • Language certificate

Application Process

Applications must be submitted through the online application portal. The application deadline is 15 November 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Application dates

Official Links

  • Application Portal: https://www.geisteswissenschaften.fu-berlin.de/en/friedrichschlegel/index.html
  • Funding Information: https://www.geisteswissenschaften.fu-berlin.de/en/friedrichschlegel/foerderung

Contact

Freie Universität Berlin
Department of Philosophy and Humanities
Habelschwerdter Allee 45, 14195 Berlin
E-Mail: applyatfsgs.fu-berlin.de

Important Notes

  • The FSGS is a structured doctoral program that can only be studied full-time.
  • External funding is strongly recommended. Self-financing through non-academic part-time employment is discouraged.
  • Partially funded: Up to 5 nine-month scholarships of EUR 1103 are available. Other positions require external funding.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
